thread:
nina: quick syncwe need a simple rule for SI crediting when a lead comes via marketplace + SI later drives the close. proposal below.

omar: yes pls keep it simple. current chaos: multiple teams add notes and no clear credit path.

pat: proposal A: first-touch = marketplace intake owner, last-touch = closer (AE). SI gets referral credit if they add `si_influence=true` before opportunity stage=proposal. referral bonus = 10% of partner credit.

zuri: question: how to verify `si_influence`? should be an activity log entry with brief justification (demo, design win, POC). otherwise contested claims will explode.

si-bot: [bot] New rule draft saved: rule_id=si-credit-v2. Trigger=opportunity_stage_change -> check si_influence tag + activity_log.

nina: verification flow: require at least one logged SI activity with one-sentence note and date. Example activity: "SI: ran 2-hr architecture workshop; recommended private deployment; customer POC approved." If present, SI referral flag valid.

omar: edge-case: when field-advocate already has ownership. do we allow SI to claim referral credit? maybe only if field-advocate signs off or tags `si_shared=true`.

pat: operational rules to add: - automatic CRM tag `si_referral` when validated - reduce duplicate claims by locking `si_referral` for 7 days after set - conflicts send an auto-digest to #partner-credit for manual adjudication.

zuri: joint-demo etiquette: if SI schedules demo, AE must be invited as co-host. record demo outcome in activity log with attendee list. Helps credit verification.

legal: quick note on public joint announcements: need partner PR approval + basic customer opt-in. I'll add a template clause to the announcement checklist.

nina: good. also propose a small webhook enrichment that adds: canonical_domain, existing_owner, last_customer_touch. sample payload: 
```json
{ "lead_id":"L-9091", "source":"marketplace", "partner":"SI-Forge", "account":"Globex", "canonical_domain":"globex.com", "existing_owner":"ae_jordan", "last_customer_touch":"2026-03-15" }
```

omar: ops ask: make the default conflict timeout 48h before escalation to #partner-credit. too short?

pat: 48h seems fine for SMB/mid. enterprise -> 72h. align with tiering.

zuri: final checklist to publish: 1) how to tag (si_influence+si_referral), 2) verification sample notes, 3) demo co-host rule, 4) conflict escalation path, 5) webhook sample.

si-bot: [bot] Draft published to Confluence: /partners/si-credit-playbook. Pilot: next 30 days.

nina: perfect please react with :white_check_mark: once you've reviewed the playbook. we'll iterate after pilot.
